w: In the evening assembly, Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was colorfully honored and carried in a procession by elated children, youths and seniors. The pageant weaved into the assembly hall amidst a thunderous welcome. Swamishri worshipped the Lord and performed arti. The assembly climaxed with the honor and service accorded to Lord Harikrishna Maharaj by the devotees. Six-thousand devotees had attended the assembly.

This morning a devotee introduced his friend to Swamishri and said, "His father was highly respected and famous in Gandhinagar. The people of Gandhinagar had attended his father's funeral procession." As the conversation progressed, Swamishri learnt that the well-wisher had an addiction to liquor. Swamishri advised him, "You should preserve the values your father lived and was famous for. Alcohol is a sin. You must get rid of it..." The well-wisher pledged to give up his drinking habit.
17 March, 2000 Devotion to Thakorji, Gandhinagar

This evening, Swamishri was on his way to the assembly hall. The procession to honor Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was all ready. Four teenage members were holding a palanquin in which the small murti of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj had been placed. On seeing the murti, Swamishri immediately turned towards the palanquin, took off his slippers, touched the feet of the Lord and placed a flower at His holy feet. Devotion and affinity for the Lord is a natural, fluent part of Swamishri's life.
18 March 2000 Faith and Effort Recognized Gandhinagar, Sarangpur

Swamishri departed from Gandhinagar at 5.00 p.m. On the way to Sarangpur Swamishri saw 30 youths who had embarked upon a pilgrimage by running from Amdavad to Sarangpur - 150 kms. Swamishri instructed the driver to stop and then blessed the youths and enquired about the details of the pilgrimage. Swamishri then waited to bless four youths who were at the rear of the group. However on seeing that they were too far behind Swamishri had his car reversed and blessed the elated youths. Swamishri appreciated and recognized the effort and devotion of the youths.
29 March Honouring the Champions, Sarangpur

This evening, Swamishri visited the mandir's 'Yagnapurush Gaushala' (cattle shed). Before arriving there Swamishri asked for some garlands because he wished to honor the domestic animals who had won national awards in a recent competition in New Delhi. Swamishri blessed and garlanded the bull, Nagnath, who had claimed the Bharat Kesari award - the highest honor in the national competition. Then Swamishri garlanded Manidhar, the father of Nagnath and a former national award winner, who has been sick since several months. Swamishri sprinkled holy water on Manidhar, prayed and blessed him for an early liberation. While individually blessing all the award winning animals, Swamishri, at one point waited for more garlands to arrive in order to honour them.
Whatever you attain through righteousness and effort will give you absolute happiness and peace.
Talk about the glory and virtues of others and you will experience peace in life.

Gunatitanand Swami says that one should turn blind, deaf and cripple. By not seeing another's (faults) actions means turning blind. By not listening to (derogatory) talks about another means turning deaf. We have not come to see what someone else is doing. God is there to see over others.

At 10.00 am Swamishri departed from Sarangpur and arrived in Barvala to inaugurate a cattle camp organized by 'Shri Baldevbhai Dosa Charitable Trust'. Swamishri blessed the assembly prior to the opening of the cattle camp.

· At 10.0 a.m., Swamishri performed the foundation-stone laying ceremony of C.K. Pithawala College of Engineering and Technology. Thereafter, an assembly commenced wherein the principal contributor for this project and Chairman of the Navyug Vidya Bhavan Trust, Shri C.K.Pithawala, welcomed Swamishri. Many distinguished dignitaries, namely, Shri Hemantbhai Chapatwala - State Minister for Law and Order and Education, Shri Kashiram Rana, - Union Minister for Textiles, Shri Jayendrabhai Bhatt - Vice Chancellor of South Gujarat University, etc., had also attended the function. In his address, Swamishri pointed out the need for value-based education and the necessity of spiritualism in life.

In the evening, during the Sunday Satsang assembly, the local kishores performed a drama on 'Niyam, nischay and paksh.' Finally, Swamishri addressed the assembly, saying, "Many times you may feel that as householders you have lots of mundane responsibilities and duties, therefore it is not possible to practice 'niyams', perform arti and puja and attend discourses. But look at Janak and Ambrish who were kings. They had a lot of activities, yet they took out time for prayer and spiritual practices. Dada Khachar, Parvatbhai, Zinabhai and others also took time out and worshipped Bhagwan Swaminarayan. One attains success by effort, faith and trust..."

This morning, an assembly to celebrate the 174th birth anniversary of Bhagatji Maharaj was held. Pujya Bhaktavatsal Swami, Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami, Pujya Bhaktipriya Swami (Kothari Swami) and Pujya Balmukund Swami spoke about the glory of Bhagatji Maharaj. Finally, Swamishri elaborated upon the divinity that Bhagatji Maharaj had in Gunatitanand Swami when he asked him about the 64 pilgrim places. Swamishri also mentioned the incident about Bhagatji Maharaj's service in offering four bucketfuls of water to each of the 300 mango trees in Maliya Hatina.
After darshan of Thakorji, Pramukh Swami Maharaj came before Hanumanji and Ganapatiji.
Sevavatsal Swami said, "Maharaj told Premanand Swami that the means for constantly keeping his murti in mind are different. So what are those means?"

Swamishri said, "Live in a way that pleases Maharaj, give up acting by your own wishes, do not see faults in or feel dislike for others, and look at our own nature and faults, not at those of others. Then God is pleased."

At the end of the meetings, the little child of Devendra Jadav (the driver) came near Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Everyone told this one-year-old child, "Bend down and touch Bapa's feet." But he was absorbed in his childish play and was looking around. Everyone tried hard to persuade him, but he would not listen, so Swamishri said, "Do not stay stiff from now on. Before God and the Sant, bow your head properly at once." Swamishri gave him the values of satsang from his very infancy.

Today, when Pramukh Swami Maharaj came for his puja, Narayanmuni Swami was giving a katha. When he finished the katha and came to Swamishri, Swamishri said, "Wah! Now it is right." Saying this, he expressed his pleasure. Behind this was yesterday's arrangement.

Yesterday, Subhashbhai of Dar es Salaam's artistic home shrine had been placed behind Swamishri. However, because the throne was low, it looked as if Swamishri's back was towards the murti of Shriji Maharaj. Yesterday, after the puja, Swamishri had pointed out to them that care should be taken to maintain the proper respect for Thakorji. In the evening too, while meeting Narayanmuni Swami and other sadhus, Swamishri mentioned the same thing and told them, "Those who arranged it are all new, that is all right, but we should understand." Having said this he added, "When I sat down to do puja, I kept thinking, what will happen? What will happen? So take care." Saying this, he had instructed, "Do five dandvat to Thakorji asking forgiveness."

Today, in keeping with Swamishri's wish and the tradition of the Sanstha, the murti of Shriji Maharaj had been placed in a high position. Seeing this, Swamishri said the words above and expressed his satisfaction.
Hariprakash Swami also gave his talk. Aksharcharan Swami said, "This is Hariprakashdas."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Is he a das (servant)?"
Hariprakash Swami said, "I am your servant, but becoming the servant of everyone seems difficult."
Swamishri said, "That is exactly what has to be done, even if it is difficult. If we become servants, we become free of ego."
A phone call came from Atmaswarup Swami in Delhi. He gave the news that today the number of visitors to Akshardham in Delhi had reached two crore (20 million).
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "When did it open?"
Atmaswarup Swami said, "If we leave out holidays and so on, it has been 1,370 days. You had said that lakhs would come, but it has become crores."
Swamishri said, "It will grow even more. The facilities are good and everyone has good darshan, so everyone will receive good values and everyone will be happy."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj was having his evening meal. Meanwhile Aksharatit Swami said, "When we see you eating only khichdi, we feel you should eat on our behalf, so that we too may get strength."
Swamishri said, "Eating does not give much strength. Strength comes only from talks about God's glory."

After his meal and reading letters, as he stood up to go to rest for the night, Pramukh Swami Maharaj suddenly said, "Come, Maharaj!" Having said this, he added, "Earlier I could stand up in a flash. Now I can stand only when someone comes and helps me up."

ds.t: The means to keep the murti always

Swamishri said, "Live in a way that pleases Maharaj, give up doing as your mind wants, do not take faults or dislike, and look at your own natures and faults, not those of others. Then God is pleased."

At the end of the meetings, Divya, the little son of Devendra Jadav (Sarthi), came close to Swamishri. Everyone told this one year old child, "Bend down and bow to Bapa." Before God and the Sant, bow your head properly in an instant." Swamishri fed him the values of satsang along with his first milk.

ds.t: Two crore visitors at Delhi Akshardham
w: A call came from Atmaswarup Swami in Delhi. He gave the news that today the number of visitors for darshan at Delhi Akshardham had reached two crore (twenty million).
Swamishri said, "When did it open?"
Atmaswarup Swami said, "Leaving out closed days and so on, it has been 1370 days. You had said lakhs would come, but this has become crores."
Swamishri said, "It will grow more. There are good facilities and everyone gets good darshan, so everyone will receive good values and everyone will be happy."

Today, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was going towards the assembly hall to give darshan of his puja, on the way an eight year old boy named Sharad recited one of Swami's talks: "If there is God, the Sadhu, faith and true scriptures, then God can be worshipped. Of these, faith is missing; everything else is there." He asked Swamishri, "Swami! How does such faith come?"
"Through understanding his glory," Swamishri said.

ds.p: On the flight from Ahmedabad to Nairobi
w: Mahant Swami Maharaj's letter work was in progress. A letter had come from a youth in London. Expressing his confusion, he had written, "Many people say that you are the Satpurush and the form of Shriji Maharaj. But I do not understand this. I have read many letters and articles, yet I still do not understand. I feel that you should send me a handwritten letter and say that you are the form of Maharaj; only then will I believe it. I will wait for your handwritten reply."
Hearing this letter, Swamishri said, "It is so. It is the form of God."
The attendant sadhu requested and asked, "Swami! Will you write it in the letter?"
Swamishri took paper and pen in his hand... and began to write. Those words are given here exactly as they were:

"Maharaj says, God or the Sant is always manifest. It is only a matter of the soul recognising him. For us, Gunatitanand Swami, Bhagatji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj are present. And they will always remain manifest. Shastriji Maharaj says, 'The Satpurush never leaves the earth.' And Yogibapa says, 'In the future too, God will remain manifest through the Sant.'
Jai Shri Swaminarayan with much love from Sadhu Keshavjivandas.
In the air, Ahd. to NRB." (That is, in the air travelling from Ahmedabad to Nairobi...) (12.20 p.m.)
